question: Which of the following gases is primarily liberated during oxidation of the weld pool in oxy-acetylene welding?
solution:
The correct answer is __Carbon dioxide**(CO₂)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Oxidation of the weld pool__ occurs during oxy-acetylene welding due to the combustion of acetylene and oxygen.
 
• The reaction primarily releases carbon dioxide (CO₂) as a byproduct.
 
• During the welding process, acetylene (C₂H₂) combusts in the presence of oxygen to produce heat and carbon dioxide.
 
• It ensures the formation of a protective atmosphere, preventing contamination of the weld pool.
 
• Proper adjustment of the gas mixture is crucial to avoid excessive oxidation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Oxy-acetylene Welding:**
 
 
• It is commonly referred to as gas welding or torch welding.
 
• This method uses acetylene and oxygen to create a flame with sufficient heat for melting the metal.
 
 
 
• **Combustion Process:**
 
 
• The combustion of acetylene produces carbon dioxide and water vapor as end products.
 
• It is essential to maintain the correct fuel-to-oxygen ratio to achieve the desired welding temperature.
 
 
 
• **Safety Considerations:**
 
 
• Ensure proper ventilation to prevent buildup of gases like carbon monoxide or other harmful substances.
 
• Use appropriate protective equipment to shield against heat and sparks.
